note: ffp.kicker (S6.3): FG and PAT attempts ~ Binomial(trials, mean/trials), log mean = intercept + itt * Implied Team Total + fav_by * expected margin + season * (season - reference_season); the two joined by a Gaussian copula with attempts_latent_rho; each FG's distance from fg_distance (pmf[i] = P(lo + i yards), the last seasons only: distance drifts up), made with logit p = intercept + per_yard_over_40 * (yards - 40) + season * (season - reference_season); a blocked FG is a miss. Rebuild every season.
